scope: Original Minyar programs with independent literal oracles for explicitly reviewed finite peer arithmetic profiles. No source-cache or build-directory runtime dependency.

domain.oracle: Independent signed magnitude quotient; every source-width unsigned guard and wrapped next induction value explicitly modeled.
domain.adaptation: Ordered parameter vectors replace unsupported wrapping induction. Preserve each helper call and each direct constant-divisor comparison. Every quotient/input for all two-complement int value widths16..64 fits signed64; wider target boundary values do not. No Minyar wrapping arithmetic or unsigned storage claim.

long32-int32.adaptation: Materialized exact fixed-seed generator corpus at the stated profile. Every applicable cell checks independently derived stored quotient/remainder, bound, signed recomposition and remainder sign. Explicit signed8/16 narrowing is retained. This is the complete named profile, not all possible C executions. Generator unsigned arithmetic, unrepresentable unsigned64 and source undefined ABS(MIN) cells are excluded with complete per-slot proof.
